## Changes

### Library
- In Bookmarks, long press comics to select them, then open the **⋮** menu: **Mark as read** marks every chapter of the selected comics read, and **Mark as unread** clears their reading progress (after you confirm). Set categories, Migrate source and Delete moved into the same menu.

### Reader
- A page that fails to load shows **Try again**. Tap it, or anywhere on the page, to load just that page again, without leaving the chapter.

### Look
- The titles of Bookmarks, History and More stay at the top while you scroll.
- Screen titles are a little smaller.

### Extensions
- ReiManga 1.1.1: some series no longer show an empty chapter list. Update it from **More → Extensions**.
